title: 'Where is Amit Shah?': Lok Sabha adjourned amid Opposition protests
summary: Opposition MPs disrupted the Lok Sabha, demanding a statement from the Home Minister on NEET student protests, leading to adjournment.

title: We don't need NEET or CUET. School-leaving exams should be enough
summary: NEET and JEE have created a format that has caused untold damage to the meaning and purpose of true education.

title: Gen-AI may replace 8-12% of India's non-agricultural jobs: Goldman Sachs
summary: Generative Artificial Intelligence (Gen-AI) could substitute 8-12 per cent of India's non-agricultural employment, while complementing 42-48 per cent of jobs.
